name: CRM Core Commerce
description: Handling the creation of contacts after the order was placed.
project_description: This module creates and updates crm_core individuals after a user has placed a Drupal Commerce order. It subscribes to the order 'place' workflow transition and maps the order's billing profile and email onto a CRM Core Individual. After enabling the module go to Config > CRM Core > Commerce Settings (/admin/config/crm-core/commerce/settings) and select which crm_core_individual bundle new/updated individuals should use. To customise the mapped data, implement hook_crm_core_individual_data_alter(array &$data, OrderInterface $order), or extend the mapper service crm_core_commerce.individual_mapper (Drupal\crm_core_commerce\Mapper\CrmCoreIndividualMapper).
